details:
`*.twitch.tv` is on the [video player allowlist](https://creators.vrchat.com/worlds/udon/video-players/www-whitelist/), but clips from Twitch cannot be played without allowing untrusted URLs. I believe this is unintended.

What works:

- Live streams on Twitch.tv (`*.ttvnw.net`), for example https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat

- Twitch VODs (`d2nvs31859zcd8.cloudfront.net`), for example from https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/videos

What doesn't work:

- Twitch clips (`d1ndex63qxojbr.cloudfront.net`), for example from https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/clips

Steps to reproduce:

1. Pick a Twitch video clip and its URL from https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/clips.

2. Navigate to VRChat settings in-client and make sure "Allow Untrusted URLs" setting is off in Comfort & Safety Settings.

3. Play the chosen Twitch clips URL in a video player, in a private instance (Friends+). (https://www.twitch.tv/vrchat/clip/HeartlessCrispyZebraSeemsGood-ewpkUK0lnSYLyIuJ)

4. Notice the playback fails.

5. Allow Untrusted URLs in the Comfort & Safety Settings.

6. Play the Twitch Clip URL from step 3 again.

7. Notice the playback succeeds.

Expected result: Twitch Clips should play without untrusted URLs, because they're functionally not any different to allowlisted VODs the clips come from.

Actual result: The `d1ndex63qxojbr.cloudfront.net` domain for Twitch Clips is missing from the video player allowlist (fetched from https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/config), and the video playback fails when the user has disabled "Allow Untrusted URLs" in VRChat (which is also the default setting).
title: Twitch Clips cannot be played without allowing untrusted URLs; d1ndex63qxojbr.cloudfront.net domain is missing from the video player allowlist
